Meal Timing Pattern
+14% post-meal stability

"When eating Masala Dosa with coconut chutney, your glucose rise peaks at ~2 hours instead of 45 minutes."

The healthy fats from coconut chutney and roasted dal naturally slow stomach emptying. Consider discussing a dual-split bolus or taking part of your dose 30 minutes after eating with your educator.

Deterministic Observation (No AI or Diagnostic Conclusions):

Observed across 7 logged dosa meals over the past 21 days in demo logs. Glucose numbers are neutral data. Patterns turn raw readings into practical, shame-free ideas to try.
